p: separated themselves from the people of: From the time they came home under Zerubbabel until the coming of Ezra, they had degenerated contrary to the law of God, and married where it was not lawful, De 7:3.
princes and rulers hath been chief: That is, the governors are the chief beginners of it.
astonied: As one doubting whether God would continue his benefits toward us, or else destroy what he had begun.
over our head: That is, we are drowned in sin.
heavens: They so exceed that they cannot grow greater.
nail in his holy place: In giving us a resting place it is a comparison taken from them that still remain in a place who strike nails to hang things on, Isa 22:23.
iniquities deserve: Has not utterly cast us down and destroyed us for our sins, De 28:13.
remain yet escaped: He shows that God is just in punishing his people, and yet merciful in preserving a residue in whom he shows favour.
